explanation: The theorem is a congruence lemma specific to this library. It says that if b₁ and b₂ agree on the submodule P, then the combined expression rTensor b + lTensor b ∘ rTensor τ takes the same value for b₁ and b₂ on the image of P ⊗ P under TensorProduct.mapIncl. I grepped Mathlib for lemmas that combine `mapIncl` with `rTensor`/`lTensor`. The only hits were internal rewrites in LinearAlgebra/TensorProduct/Finiteness.lean, and none of them is a lemma of this kind. Deriving the theorem from Mathlib would take an induction over tensors or several composition and extensionality steps on the library's ReducedTensorWords type. That is more than a one- or two-line use of a single Mathlib declaration, so the verdict is none_found.
